## Summary

What changed, and why?

## How to test

- [ ] `uv run pytest` is green
- [ ] Database tests, if run, used a database whose name ends with `_test`

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages are in English
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or passwords
- [ ] User-facing behavior changes are noted (changelog or docs)
- [ ] New vendored files, if any, are listed in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`
